name: Aurora Glass
promise: Frosted panes over one living sky, the portfolio read through glass.
description: A centred capsule over a sky built from the scheme's own colours: the thesis in the identity pane with the signature work's sheet shingled across it, two glass beads in the open sky, and every destination a lite pane split by mullion gaps that show the sky, closing on the owner's horizon. Reading panes are near-opaque; only the capsule, the identity pane and its stat tiles blur.

items.label: Backdrop
items.description: Whether the page lays the owner's own landscape photograph under the sky when no sky photograph is chosen. Automatic takes the first landscape photograph in the first photography section; None leaves it out.

items.label: Sky photograph
items.description: A photograph of your own for the sky, from the media your visible sections show. When it is unset, or the photograph is gone, the Backdrop choice decides.

items.label: Sky drift
items.description: Lets the sky's curtains drift slowly while the opening is in view. It never runs under reduced motion, on touch screens, or on narrow screens.

items.label: Lens
items.description: Shows the Lens beside the opening's headline.

items.label: Proof tiles
items.description: Whether the opening shows up to three tiles from the proof strip.

sources.note: The sky, the capsule, the shingled identity pane and sheet, the Lens and the lite panes, rebuilt on the platform tokens with the panes at the language's own surface.
